channel.title: Composed Apps on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Composed Apps on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Composed App
item.description: This section describes how to create a composed app. You can customize the services, workloads, and routes of an app to create a composed app. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance Creation permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has App Instance Creation permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: View Composed App List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of composed apps. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has App Instance View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Composed Apps in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Composed App Details
item.description: This section describes how to view composed app details. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has App Instance View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Composed Apps in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Composed App Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit composed app information. You can edit the alias and description of an app. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of an already created app. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has App Instance Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete Composed App
item.description: This section describes how to delete a composed app. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the App Instance Deletion permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Delete a Single App Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has App Instance Deletion permissions and enter your workspace. Click Application Workloads > Composed Apps in the left navigation pane.
